### Statistical and Multivariate Analysis in Material Science

[Edited by Giorgio Luciano]{.book-credit}

An introduction to statistical and multivariate methods for materials science, connecting data analysis with practical research questions.

[View book ↗](https://www.routledge.com/Statistical-and-Multivariate-Analysis-in-Material-Science/Luciano/p/book/9780367775834){.book-link}

[COMPUTER GRAPHICS / SCIENTIFIC ILLUSTRATION]{.card-kicker}

### Essential Computer Graphics Techniques for Modeling, Animating, and Rendering Biomolecules and Cells

*A Guide for the Scientist and Artist*

[By Giorgio Luciano]{.book-credit}

A practical guide to creating scientific imagery, covering modeling, animation, lighting, and rendering for biomolecules and cells.

[View book ↗](https://www.routledge.com/Essential-Computer-Graphics-Techniques-for-Modeling-Animating-and-Rendering-Biomolecules-and-Cells-A-Guide-for-the-Scientist-and-Artist/Luciano/p/book/9780367780319){.book-link}

[04 / A LITTLE BACKGROUND]{.eyebrow}

## About me

I hold a PhD in materials science and work as a researcher at the Italian National Research Council (CNR), focusing on the characterization and development of materials.

My interests extend to scientific computing, data analysis, 3D graphics, lighting, rendering, and scientific illustration. This site brings those interests together: things I write, tools I build, and images I create.

[Code on GitHub ↗](https://github.com/giorgioluciano) · [Connect on LinkedIn ↗](https://www.linkedin.com/in/giorgioluciano/)
